schedule.title: This week on the floor
schedule.body: 42 coached classes a week, capped at 14 people. Every class lists its target zone, RPE and the main sets, so you know what you are walking into before you book.

classes.name: Engine 45
classes.format: 4 × 8 min row / bike at nose-breathing pace, 2 min easy between

classes.name: Sled & Carry
classes.format: 6 rounds: 20 m sled push, 40 m farmer’s carry, 90 s rest

classes.name: Kettlebell Complex
classes.format: EMOM 24: swing, clean, press, front squat × 5

classes.name: Max Effort
classes.format: Work up to a heavy single, then 3 × 3 @ 90%

max.title: Find your 1-rep max
max.body: Enter a recent set you finished with good form. We estimate your one-rep max, build your training percentages and show exactly which plates go on each side of the bar.

join.eyebrow: Membership · no joining fee in October
join.title: Pick your zone
join.body: Every plan includes the full floor: 8 squat racks, 4 lifting platforms, calibrated plates, air bikes, rowers and a 20 m sled lane. Cancel with 30 days' notice.
join.monthlyNote: Billed monthly · cancel with 30 days’ notice

features: Chalk, belts and wrist wraps on the rack
Free first 1RM test with a coach
Quarterly testing day: 1RM, 2 km row, max HR
Your own 12-week block written by a coach

hours.note: 5 AM–11 PM every day, including holidays. Coaches on the floor 6 AM–9 PM.

trial.title: Book a free session
trial.body: Your first class is on us. A coach meets you 10 minutes early to fit a heart-rate strap and check your squat.

footer.fine: Ventricle Strength Club is a made-up business for a concept site.
